wvt: IQ waveform visualization tool¶

wvt is an X11 desktop tool for raw IQ recordings from software-defined radios (SDRs).

  • The left side of the window shows a spectrum and a waterfall.

  • The right side shows I/Q, AM, FM and PM plots. These plots share one time axis.

  • When you pan or zoom one plot, all the other plots follow.

wvt has these other functions:

  • Live devices: wvt streams from an RTL-SDR v3, a USRP (B200 family, N3xx, X3xx, X4xx), a Signal Hound BB60 or an Epiq Sidekiq. It shows the spectrum and the waterfall in real time, and it records the stream to a file.

  • Signal generator: wvt makes CW, pulsed, swept and recorded waveforms. It writes them to a file, shows them in the live view, or transmits them with a USRP.

  • Audio: wvt demodulates one channel and plays it through the speakers or writes it to a WAV file.

  • Region export: wvt writes a time range, and as an option a frequency band, to a new file.

  • GPU processing: wvt can do the signal processing on an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA) or an Apple GPU (Metal).

Start with Getting started. For all the build settings, refer to Build reference.
